note: Reference facts about each market that no database can derive: the standard a building is held to, how its consumption data arrives, and what the energy is billed in. Every value here is labelled `reference` when served; anything the deployment can measure for itself (buildings in scope, the tariff actually contracted, the routes actually on record, a portfolio benchmark) overrides the reference and is labelled accordingly. Published tariffs carry an as_of date and are indicative, not a quote.
